questions.text: Which application is the primary one for Browse Nifty 100 Stocks?
questions.reason: The list page, sidebar and stock links are web work, but the Nifty 100 reference list, the daily yfinance fetch and the price data are server-side work (api). Both are needed; the primary one is where most of the work lives, and the other is listed as an additional application.

questions.text: What sort order should the stock list use by default?
questions.reason: Approved requirement lists sort order as an open question; market cap needs a data field the functional requirements do not define for the Stock table (only symbol, name, sector).

questions.text: How should the list of 100 stocks be shown?
questions.reason: Approved requirement lists pagination as not specified. A single page of 100 rows is the simplest fit for the 2-second page-load criterion.
